### The LORD Will Be King
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/lord-will-be-king
Passage: Zechariah 14:1-9
Points:
- Zechariah uses vivid apocalyptic imagery to describe the final day of history.
- When God's people seem on the brink of defeat, the Lord and His heavenly army intervene.
- Living waters flowing continuously from Jerusalem represent unending spiritual renewal for God's people.
- The Lord will be universally acknowledged as the sole, supreme King over all creation.
- Believers enjoy the blessedness of God's reign today in Christ, anticipating its complete consummation.

### The Altar of Age
Author: Truth For Life
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/truth-for-life/truth-for-life-october-4-2013.html
Passage: Zechariah 14:7
Points:
- Believers often view aging with apprehension, forgetting God's promise of light at evening time.
- The later years of life can be a peaceful season marked by mature faith and tranquil rest.
- Bodily decline and pain are borne patiently through Christ's perfected strength.
- Faith removes the terror of death, anticipating the immediate dawn of heavenly glory.
